title: Private VPC Geo-split Utilization Sensitivity Ledger
content:
Purpose:
This worksheet captures a set of regional (geo) split scenarios and a sensitivity matrix for Private/VPC GPU fleet sizing. It is intentionally conservative on headroom and enumerates tradeoffs for spot vs reserved capacity, cold spares, and per-region BOM impacts. Target audience: infra owners, solutions engineering, and finance lead for Private deals.

Quick summary: 
- Input-driven sheet: change demand profile, average tokens/req, and target p95 latency to re-compute GPUs and rack estimates per region.
- Scenarios captured: steady (baseline), seasonal surge (x2 peak), degraded (50% AVAIL), and failover (one-region-out).
- Outputs: per-region required GPUs, recommended reservation fraction, recommended cold spare nodes, rack count, core networking (Top-of-Rack), and line-item BOM estimate (GPU, CPU host, NIC, NVMe, PDU).

Assumptions (editable):
- Avg tokens per request = 64 (replace as needed)
- Model inference throughput per GPU (tokens/sec) = A100-80GB: 9,000 t/s; H100-80GB: 16,000 t/s (workload-dependent)
- Avg requests/sec per user workload derived from QPS profile input
- Latency budget influences effective concurrency window; we model token-in-flight = latency_ms / avg_token_latency_ms
- Safety multiplier (headroom) default = 1.25 for baseline, 1.5 for surge, 1.4 for failover
- Spot usable fraction default = 0.25 (25%) unless region flagged as spot-hostile
- Cold spare nodes per region default = 2 racks or 5% whichever is larger

Key input fields (user-editable cells in sheet):
- Region list: [us-west-2, us-east-1, eu-west-1, ap-southeast-2]
- Baseline QPS by region (requests/sec)
- Peak multiplier (for seasonal)
- Target p95 latency (ms)
- Model variant selection per region (A100/H100/other)
- Quantization factor (fp16/int8) impact on throughput %
- Reserved commit fraction (finance input)

Core calculation formulas (human-readable)
- tokens_per_sec_per_gpu = throughput_lookup(model_variant) * quantization_multiplier
- tokens_per_request = avg_tokens_per_request
- requests_per_sec_per_gpu = floor(tokens_per_sec_per_gpu / tokens_per_request)
- required_gpus_raw = region_qps / requests_per_sec_per_gpu
- required_gpus_with_headroom = ceil(required_gpus_raw * safety_multiplier)
- spot_gpus_recommendation = floor(required_gpus_with_headroom * spot_fraction)  // only if spot allowed
- reserved_gpus = required_gpus_with_headroom - spot_gpus_recommendation
- racks_required = ceil((reserved_gpus + cold_spares) / gpus_per_rack)
- total_bom_cost = sum(line_item_qty_i * unit_cost_i) per region

Representative table (example rows):
Region | BaselineQPS | Model | Quant | tokens/req | t/s/gpu | req_gpus_raw | safety_mult | req_gpus_final | spot_frac | spot_gpus | reserved_gpus | cold_spares | racks | est_monthly_cost
us-west-2 | 1200 | H100-80 | 0.9 | 64 | 14400 | 8.8 -> 8 | 1.25 | 10 | 0.25 | 2 | 8 | 1 | 1 | $88,000
us-east-1 | 900  | A100-80 | 1.0 | 64 | 9000  | 5.7 -> 6 | 1.25 | 8  | 0.25 | 2 | 6 | 1 | 1 | $57,000
eu-west-1 | 400  | A100-80 | 1.0 | 64 | 9000  | 2.8 -> 3 | 1.25 | 4  | 0.25 | 1 | 3 | 1 | 1 | $28,000
ap-south-2 | 150  | H100-80 | 0.9 | 64 | 14400 | 1.1 -> 1 | 1.25 | 2  | 0.1  | 0 | 2 | 1 | 1 | $18,000

BOM line items (per GPU host/rack):
- GPU card unit cost: H100-80GB = $25,000; A100-80GB = $12,000
- Host server (CPU, mem, mobo): $9,500
- 100Gbps NIC: $1,200
- NVMe pool (per host): $1,800
- Rack + PDU + cabling per rack: $6,000
- Top-of-Rack switch (100Gbps): $18,000 (amortized across racks)
- Cross-connect / transit buffer: $2,000 per region per month (ops)
- Power and Cooling uplift contingency: 15% of hardware spend

Example BOM calc (us-west-2):
- Required GPUs final = 10 -> distribute across hosts at 8xGPUs/host => 2 hosts (16 GPU slots used)
- GPU cost = 10 * 25,000 = $250,000
- Host cost = 2 * 9,500 = $19,000
- NIC = 2 * 1,200 = $2,400
- NVMe = 2 * 1,800 = $3,600
- Rack cost (1 rack) = $6,000
- TOR switch prorated = $18,000
- subtotal HW = $299,000
- contingency 15% = $44,850
- total capex region = $343,850

Sensitivity matrix (what to edit and observe):
- Vary peak multiplier from 1.0 to 3.0: observe reserved_gpus delta and monthly amortized cost delta
- Vary safety_multiplier between 1.1 and 1.6: headroom vs capital efficiency tradeoff
- Toggle spot_fraction 0 -> 0.6: evaluate risk vs unit cost savings; reflect in ops risk cell
- Change model choice H100 <-> A100 to see unit throughput and BOM delta

Failover / one-region-out scenario:
- Re-route X% of traffic to other regions (configurable). For each target region, recompute: new_qps = baseline_qps + diverted_qps. Apply failover safety multiplier (default 1.4). Recommended action: reserve additional temporary capacity or rely on on-demand cloud bursting (customer discussion).

Open questions and TODOs: 
- Confirm up-to-date vendor pricing for H100 and A100; current market variance can be +/- 15%.
- Decide policy for spot eviction handling (automatic drain vs manual failover). This sheet assumes automatic drain with 15-min recovery window.
- Add an optional column for 'model quantization impact measured on perf test' to override default quantization multiplier per region.
- Validate per-region power availability constraints against site PUE and PDUs.

Action items: 
- Diego: run perf microbenchmarks for region-specific token distribution (due 2026-02-18).
- Lina: confirm procurement lead times and vendor discounts for H100 in EU (due 2026-02-25).
- Tom: align finance on acceptable reserved commit fraction and amortization window for Private deals (due 2026-02-10).

Notes to reviewers: 
- This is a working spreadsheet intended to be converted into the automated sizing CLI in repo private-deploy-tools. Please flag any missing line-items (ops subscriptions, rack installation T&M) and annotate cells that should be parameterized into the CLI.
- There are shorthand cells with inline formulas; before finalizing with customer, we should run a full break-even analysis comparing reserved-only vs 60% reserved + 40% spot for 36-month amortization.

Revision history:
- 2025-10-15 initial draft by Avery Chen
- 2025-11-02 added region failover column and cold spare heuristics
- 2026-01-12 updated throughput numbers based on perf lab run (H100 updates)
- 2026-02-08 updated BOM costs and action items

Unresolved: 
- Exact gpus_per_rack target (we used 8 as default) should be validated against chassis vendor and airflow in private datacenter site.

End of sheet.
